verdict.rationale: Clerk documents API keys and M2M tokens as machine credentials for programmatic callers and agents, with API keys bound to a specific user or org. Scoping is documented through OAuth scoped access, custom OAuth scopes for MCP clients, and gating individual agent tool calls against the caller's permissions and scopes. Machine authentication is a metered platform feature. Missing for 10: explicit docs showing per-key or per-M2M-token scope or permission restriction, any least-privilege scoping for Backend API personal access tokens, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
